findings.motion: On Passage, H.R. 22, SAVE Act (Roll Call 102)
findings.note: She voted Nay on passage of H.R. 22, the SAVE Act, which requires documentary proof of citizenship when registering to vote in federal elections. The bill passed the House 220 to 208. Ballotpedia also lists this vote as Nay.

Roll call 102, On Passage of H.R. 22, the SAVE Act. The Clerk's page lists her as Nay. The bill passed 220 to 208. The SAVE Act requires documentary proof of citizenship to register and a photo ID to vote in person.
